_provenance.what_this_file_is: A SUBSET of official NIST ACVP known-answer test data for ML-KEM encapDecap (FIPS203), filtered to parameterSet=ML-KEM-768 and capped at 3 test case(s) per test group. Fields prefixed `expected_` come from the source's expectedResults.json (the answer key); all other fields come from prompt.json (the question/input). This file is a REFORMATTING for readability — it is NOT a byte-identical copy of any single official file. The byte-identical originals are at the URLs and git blob SHAs below; re-fetch those to verify this subset was not altered.
